description:
Goal
Make pattern-dispatch reachability preserve the set-theoretic correlation of original input types through every tuple/list/map projection, then reuse that one calculator for semantic clause reachability and exhaustiveness.

Root defect
The failed fz-1ah.1 prototype converted each ContractArrow parameter Ty into a parallel KnownSubjectDomain tree, then stored one independent domain per projected SubjectId. Refining a tuple field or list head detached it from the originating union, so sibling projections invented impossible cross-products. Boundary-lifting patches moved the loss around: tuple siblings improved, tuple->list->head lost correlation. The pre-existing semantic reachable_clause_ids has the same structural smell: HashMap<SubjectId, Ty> plus apply_evidence refining projected subjects independently; concrete activation inputs often hide it.

Authoritative model
- FunctionContract arrows retain correlated parameter Ty rows.
- PatternDispatchPlan retains original input subjects, projection paths, predicates, and branch-local EdgeEvidence.
- Types already owns intersection, complement, difference, tuple/list projection, and emptiness.

Strategy
Represent traversal state only at original input roots (one correlated contract arrow row at a time) plus accumulated path evidence. For a predicate on any projected subject:
1. turn the Region into a Ty constraint at that subject;
2. compute its preimage back through the complete projection path (tuple field, list head/tail, map where supported) to the original input root;
3. match edge = intersect(root, preimage); miss edge = difference(root, preimage);
4. prune an edge iff the refined root is empty;
5. derive later projections fresh from the refined root, never from detached child slots.
Unknown/value-only predicates conservatively keep both edges. Guards use exact constant truth when available and otherwise keep fallthrough possible.

Unification/removal
Extract one Types-backed dispatch reachability calculator and replace compiler2/jobs/semantic.rs reachable_clause_ids/branch_possible/apply_evidence. Do not keep KnownSubjectDomain generalized algebra, tuple-boundary heuristics, or a second diagnostics traversal. The old test-only simple-list helper can disappear when its intent is covered by the shared calculator.

TDD
Pin semantic reachability and Fail reachability for:
- {:a,:x}|{:b,:y} exact vs cross-wired;
- {:a,[true]}|{:b,[false]} through tuple->list->head;
- nested tuples and list-of-tuples;
- overload arrows without cross-arrow products;
- wide 16-field unions with a bounded graph/state signal;
- match/miss difference and unknown guards.
Use production FunctionContract/PatternDispatchPlan/Types paths.

Acceptance
- Correlation is preserved across arbitrary supported projection chains without Cartesian materialization.
- Semantic reachable clauses and exhaustiveness share one calculator.
- Unsupported predicates are conservative, never unsound.
- Parallel KnownSubjectDomain machinery and failed boundary heuristics are deleted.
- Docs/tests/clippy pass.
title: Preserve root type correlation through dispatch projections
